answer_2.quote: We evaluate the trained model on the MTEB benchmark . Note that the retrieval category in MTEB corresponds to the 15 publicly available datasets in the BEIR benchmark . Evaluation of one model takes about 3 days on 8 V100 GPUs due to the need to encode a large number of documents. Although our model can accommodate sequence length beyond 512, we only evaluate on the first 512 tokens for efficiency. Official metrics are reported for each category.
